note: SLO County Parks campground in an oak grove off Hwy 1 between San Luis Obispo and Morro Bay, across the highway from Cuesta College; Dairy Creek Golf Course, the SLO Botanical Garden and an off-leash dog park share the park. --Claude
summary: County campground page, fee schedule and imagery read. 61 sites (43 FHU, 18 primitive) confirmed; fees $48-65 -> $38-65 (stored low was the electric-only class El Chorro doesn't have; primitive sites take an RV); $12 reservation fee, extra vehicle $15; 40 ft max at some sites, a couple of pull-throughs; coin showers; year-round; county WebTrac booking, 180-day window. Website moved. Phone supplied. Not waterfront kept.
